behaviors.behavior: Inside the registered project root: relative and absolute paths served; traversal/NUL/empty rejected; symlink/junction leaving the root rejected
Outside the project only with session evidence: Write output, assistant text, user text, Bash tool call
tool_result, bash/local-command output, isMeta and compact-summary records never count; other task's transcript grants nothing
Whole-path matching: sibling extension, parent dir, +/@/%/#/$ and shell prefixes do not evidence
Credential locations refused (.ssh, prod.env, hosts.yml, mcp.json, .claude.json); project scope keeps ordinary auth.json/hosts.yml
Symlink hop needs real target named; directory never listed; 404 only after evidence; UNC/foreign drive paths invalid; Windows case/slash insensitive
415 binary/NUL, 413 over 5 MB, read-only (transcript untouched), non-ASCII/CRLF/BOM transcript
Scan queue: failing scan does not poison the next; parallel calls resolve; no cwd root

surface_verification.justification: Server-only read-only route with no UI consumer yet (client wiring is a later campaign unit); behavior proven by 62 route/unit tests against real temp dirs, junctions and synthetic session JSONL, plus the full server suite (4883 passed).
